start_my_day.description: Start the working day: open Slack and post 'started' in #general, open the browser with the daily tabs, and open Notes. Say 'start my day', 'wake up', 'good morning', 'set me up', 'morning routine'.

focus_mode.description: Quiet everything down for deep work: mute, quit chat, get back to the browser. Say 'focus mode', 'let me focus', 'do not disturb', 'heads down', 'quiet mode'.

wrap_up.description: End the working day: post 'ended' in Slack #general and leave a note for tomorrow. Say 'wrap up', 'end my day', "let's end the day", "that's me done", 'good night', 'shutting down'.

steps.text:
Tomorrow
Pick up where I left off.

send_break.description: Tell the team you're stepping away: post 'break' in Slack #general. Say 'send break in slack', 'send break', 'I'm on a break', 'taking a break', 'break time', 'going on break'.
